# Lemo-Opuscar (kept copy)

Source: https://github.com/lemomo-ai/lemo-opuscar (MIT, see LICENSE and LICENSES/)
Commit: 8ca0dd805e214bcc1d30714cd5b9d21cc02a454b (2026-11-23)

What is kept: every style's STYLE.md / DEMO.md / style.json, the demo films' source code, core/, tools/, the
guides (DIRECTOR.md, TECHNIQUE.md, MY-STYLES.md) and the Claude Code plugin/skill in plugin/.
What is left out to keep this repository small: preview images and media (posters, stills, webp/jpg/png,

Nothing here has been installed or run. To install the official skill instead, see README.md ("Install").
